- status-icon (registry:block) - Unified status icon component with variants for different contexts [@openstatus]

- status-timestamp (registry:block) - Interactive timestamp display with tooltip (simple) or hover-card (rich) variants showing multiple timezone formats [@openstatus]

- status-banner (registry:block) - Alert-style status banner with tabs support and timestamp display [@openstatus]

- status-component (registry:block) - Monitor component primitives for building status displays [@openstatus] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-component-group (registry:block) - Collapsible group wrapper for status components [@openstatus] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-events (registry:block) - Event timeline components for displaying status reports and maintenance updates [@openstatus] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-bar (registry:block) - Interactive status timeline with hover, keyboard navigation, and event display [@openstatus] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- status-calendar (registry:block) - Monthly calendar view of status history with per-day markers and event hover cards [@openstatus]

- status-locale-switcher (registry:block) - Agnostic locale picker. Caller owns value, onValueChange, and label resolution — no next-intl, router, or locale detection [@openstatus]

- status-updates (registry:block) - Popover with copy-link primitives for RSS, Atom, JSON, Slack, and SSH subscription channels. Flat exports — caller composes layout (tabs, sections, etc.) [@openstatus]

- status-page-get-in-touch (registry:block) - Two flat button primitives (icon + text) with tooltip chrome for the contact link in a status page header [@openstatus]

- status-page-header (registry:block) - Presentation-only header chrome (brand, nav, actions). Routing-agnostic — apps inject their own Link component via asChild [@openstatus]

- status-page-footer (registry:block) - Presentation-only footer chrome (powered-by, action cluster). Embed/white-label gating, switchers, and tRPC fetch stay in the wrapping app [@openstatus]

- status-chrome (registry:block) - Full status page chrome — shell, header, footer, get-in-touch, status-updates, theme + locale switchers. Combine with status-essentials or status-complete for the body [@openstatus]

- status-complete (registry:block) - Complete status page components including all primitives, displays, interactive elements, and chrome (header / footer / switchers) [@openstatus]

- status-essentials (registry:block) - Essential status page components for basic status displays [@openstatus]
